item.title: Dolly Parton's Faith Embraced Acceptance and God
Legal experts weigh in on Lindsay Clancy's potential post-trial placement.
item.description: Lindsay Clancy has entered a not guilty plea to three counts of first-degree murder in the January 2023 deaths of her children.

item.title: Tropical Storm Dolly forms over the Atlantic Ocean
item.description: Tropical Storm Dolly, the fourth named storm of the 2026 hurricane season, developed in the Atlantic on Thursday.

item.title: Seattle Storm grants young fan's wish to join the team
item.description: Eleven-year-old Charlotte, through the Make-A-Wish Foundation, spent a day as a Storm player.
